name: Morning adhkar
description: Short daily invocations recited after Fajr until sunrise.

duas.name: Tasbih of the morning
duas.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhan-Allahi wa bihamdihi
duas.translation: Glory is to Allah, and praise is His.

duas.name: Seeking forgiveness
duas.arabic_text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh
duas.translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.

duas.name: Affirmation of Tawhid
duas.arabic_text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa-Allahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
duas.translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, with no partner; His is the dominion, His is the praise, and He is able to do all things.

duas.name: Contentment with Allah, Islam, and the Prophet ﷺ
duas.arabic_text: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
duas.transliteration: Radhitu billahi rabban, wa bil-Islami dinan, wa bi-Muhammadin ﷺ nabiyya
duas.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.

name: Evening adhkar
description: Short daily invocations recited between Asr and Maghrib.

duas.name: Tasbih of the evening
duas.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhan-Allahi wa bihamdihi 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatih
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, as much as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His throne, and as much as the ink of His words.

duas.name: Seeking refuge in the perfect words of Allah
duas.arabic_text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

duas.name: Reliance on Allah (seven times)
duas.arabic_text: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ ﴿٧×﴾
duas.transliteration: Hasbiya Allahu la ilaha illa huw, 'alayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'adhim (seven times)
duas.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I place my trust, and He is the Lord of the mighty throne.

name: After prayer
description: Recommended dhikr after the obligatory prayers.

duas.name: Istighfar (three times)
duas.arabic_text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ ﴿ثَلَاثًا﴾
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullah (three times)
duas.translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness — said three times after the salam.

duas.name: Allahumma antas-salam
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma antas-salam, wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram
duas.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of Majesty and Honour.

duas.name: Tasbih of Fatima (33-33-34)
duas.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ ﴿٣٣﴾، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ﴿٣٣﴾، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ﴿٣٤﴾
duas.transliteration: Subhan-Allah (33x), Alhamdu lillah (33x), Allahu Akbar (34x)
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah (33 times), praise be to Allah (33 times), Allah is the Greatest (34 times).

duas.name: Comprehensive dua taught by Ibn Abbas
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibadatik
duas.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of ways.

duas.name: Before eating
duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah. (If forgotten at the start, say: Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirihi.)

duas.name: After eating
duas.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi, min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
duas.translation: Praise is to Allah who has fed me this and provided it for me, without any strength or power on my part.

duas.name: After drinking water
duas.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَهُ عَذْبًا فُرَاتًا بِرَحْمَتِهِ، وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ مِلْحًا أُجَاجًا بِذُنُوبِنَا
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi ja'alahu 'adhban furatan bi-rahmatih, wa lam yaj'alhu milhan ujajan bi-dhunubina
duas.translation: Praise is to Allah who made it sweet and fresh by His mercy, and did not make it salty and bitter by our sins.

duas.name: For the host after being fed
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma at'im man at'amani, wa asqi man saqani
duas.translation: O Allah, feed the one who has fed me, and give drink to the one who has given me drink.

name: Before sleeping and on waking
description: Short adhkar for bedtime and morning.

duas.name: Before sleeping
duas.arabic_text: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
duas.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.name: On waking
duas.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
duas.translation: Praise is to Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and to Him is the resurrection.

duas.name: Seeking refuge before sleep
duas.arabic_text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa 'iqabih, wa sharri 'ibadih, wa min hamazatish-shayatini wa an yahdurun
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His servants, and from the promptings of the devils and their presence.

duas.name: Leaving home
duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi, tawakkaltu 'ala Allahi, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

duas.name: Entering home
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayral-mawliji wa khayral-makhraji, bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Allahi rabbina tawakkalna
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the best entry and the best exit. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we depend.

name: Entering and leaving the mosque
description: Short invocations at the mosque doorway.

duas.name: Entering the mosque
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik
duas.translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

duas.name: Leaving the mosque
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

name: Travel
description: Short invocations for boarding a vehicle and setting out on a journey.

duas.name: When boarding a vehicle
duas.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina la-munqalibun
duas.translation: Glory is to Him who has subjected this to us; we could never have accomplished it by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will surely return.

duas.name: For a journey
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda, Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah
duas.translation: O Allah, we ask You on this our journey for righteousness and piety, and for deeds pleasing to You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up its distance.

duas.name: Before entering
duas.arabic_text: ﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith
duas.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the male and female evil beings.

duas.name: On leaving
duas.arabic_text: غُفْرَانَكَ
duas.transliteration: Ghufranak
duas.translation: I ask Your forgiveness.

duas.name: Before wudu
duas.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah.

duas.name: After wudu
duas.arabic_text: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.transliteration: Ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Allahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh
duas.translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

name: In times of distress
description: Short invocations for anxiety, grief, and difficulty.

duas.name: In moments of hardship
duas.arabic_text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa Allahul-'adhimul-halim, la ilaha illa Allahu rabbul-'arshil-'adhim, la ilaha illa Allahu rabbus-samawati wa rabbul-ardi wa rabbul-'arshil-karim
duas.translation: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

duas.name: In anxiety and grief
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni 'abduka, ibnu 'abdika, ibnu amatik, nasiyati bi-yadika, madin fiyya hukmuka, 'adlun fiyya qada'uka, as'aluka bi-kulli ismin huwa laka sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fi kitabika, aw 'allamtahu ahadan min khalqika, aw ista'tharta bihi fi 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indak, an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabi'a qalbi, wa nura sadri, wa jala'a huzni, wa dhahaba hammi
duas.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maid-servant. My forelock is in Your hand. Your judgment is executed upon me and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours — with which You have named Yourself, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept unto Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen with You — that You make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the departer of my sorrow, and the reliever of my anxiety.

name: Rain
description: On seeing rain and when the wind blows.

duas.name: When rain falls
duas.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a
duas.translation: O Allah, make it a beneficial pouring rain.

duas.name: After rain
duas.arabic_text: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Mutirna bi-fadlillahi wa rahmatih
duas.translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
